name: Name
productLine: A Keen Eye on Your Postgres
loginHeadline: A Keen Eye on Your Postgres
loginHighlightInventory: Build and discover HA clusters on your own servers
loginHighlightPatroni: Backups, restores and upgrades with one click
loginHighlightObservability: Health, forecasts and alerts for every cluster
signInFailed: Couldn't sign in. Check that the console is running and try again.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.
obsIntro: Live health of each cluster from its Prometheus: services, alerts and the main PostgreSQL, node and etcd graphs. Grafana, Prometheus and Alertmanager open from the links; their addresses come from the Monitoring VM in the cluster's inventory and can be changed per cluster.
obsReachHint: Graphs are read by the console from the cluster's Prometheus. The Grafana / Prometheus / Alertmanager links open in your browser, so your browser has to reach those VMs (through an SSH tunnel: ssh -D 1080 root@<kvm-host> and a SOCKS proxy on localhost:1080).
obsNoClusters: No clusters in this project yet.
obsNoMonitoring: This cluster has no VM with the Monitoring role. Add one in the inventory, or set the URLs with 'Edit URLs'.
obsGrafanaHint: Dashboards for PostgreSQL, Patroni, etcd and the VMs.
obsEmbedHint: Shows Grafana inside KeenPG. Grafana must allow embedding (allow_embedding = true in grafana.ini).
obsEditHelp: Leave a field empty to use the address from the inventory.
sqlTruncated: showing the first {{shown}} rows (raise Max rows to see more)
sqlTruncatedByPolicy: showing the first {{shown}} rows (the most your access policies allow)
sqlNoRows: The statements ran but returned no rows. See Messages.
sqlRunHint: Write SQL above and press Run (F5 or Ctrl+Enter). Select text to run only that part.
sqlNoHistory: Nothing run yet. Your queries are kept here (in this browser).
sqlObjectHelp: Click for actions, double-click to insert the name
sqlViewerNotAllowed: Your role (viewer) can't run SQL. Ask an admin for the operator role to use the SQL editor.
sqlNoClusters: No cluster has connection details yet. They are saved when a deployment finishes.
sqlHelp:
F5 or Ctrl+Enter: run the selection, or the whole script
F7: EXPLAIN the selection or the statement under the cursor
Shift+F7: EXPLAIN ANALYZE (runs it)
Every statement's result is shown (SELECT, SHOW, EXPLAIN, RETURNING …)
Each run is its own session: put BEGIN … COMMIT in the same run
Queries run as the cluster superuser on the current leader (through HAProxy)
auditLoadFailed: Could not load the audit log.
auditLogHelp: Every change, every SQL statement, every log read and every refused request - who, when, from which IP, on which cluster and with what result. Click a row for details.
liveTailHint: Follow new lines as PostgreSQL writes them (every 3 s)
liveTailOnlyCurrent: Only the file PostgreSQL writes to now can be followed
noLogClusters: Your access policies don't allow reading logs on any cluster of this project.
olderHidden_one: {{count}} older entry not shown - narrow the filter or search
olderHidden_other: {{count}} older entries not shown - narrow the filter or search
olderNotLoaded: Older lines not loaded - choose a bigger size to see more
sqlNoAccess: Your access policies don't allow the SQL editor on any cluster. Ask an administrator for a policy with sql.read, sql.write or sql.admin.
sqlObjectLocked: You can't read this object (access policies)
noPermissionForPage: Your access policies don't allow this page (it needs {{perms}}). Ask an administrator if you need it.
monLoadFailed: Could not load the monitoring data.
monNoPrometheus: Prometheus could not be read ({{url}}): {{error}}. Check that the cluster has a Monitoring VM, or set the Prometheus URL with 'Edit URLs'.
monMachinesTitle: Machines by role (one entry per VM)
monNoDbTargets: Prometheus doesn't scrape any PostgreSQL or Patroni exporter for this cluster.

home_risks_sub: Warnings and forecasts from all clusters
homeCustomizeHelp: Choose the cards on this user's home page, their order, and the page they see after signing in. Only cards and pages this user's access allows are listed.
homeStartPageHelp: The page that opens after you sign in.
homeSaveFailed: Could not save your home page
homeEmpty: Your home page has no cards yet. Ask an administrator to set it up in Settings → Users.
homeNoQueries: No queries run from this browser yet.
homeNoOperations: No operations in the last 7 days.
homeNotesHint: Your own notes: runbook links, reminders, anything. Saved to your account.

home_operations_help: Deployments and changes in the last 7 days

logsCollectorOff: This server does not write log files (logging_collector is off): its log goes to {{dest}}, e.g. the system journal. Turn logging_collector on to read logs here.
loginSub: Build highly available clusters, keep them backed up, restore to any second and upgrade without downtime, from one console.
